name: Xiamen King Long Motor Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen King Long Motor Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of passenger and commercial vehicles in China and internationally. The company offers light, medium-sized, and large buses for passenger and group transport, tourism, public transport, school buses, and special vehicles under the King Long Bus and Higer Bus brands; and new energy heavy trucks, logistics vehicles, RVs, and autonomous driving products.
